proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file context lines did not match; the write_file fallback succeeded so the intended change was applied.

title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file (mod.rs)
description: Multiple patch_file failures on 'src/moeb/src/tools/mod.rs' due to incorrect line context. Recovered via write_file with complete content.
proposed_resolution: When patch_file fails on first attempt with correct context, prefer write_file for the affected file from the start to avoid recording tool errors.

title: patch_file hunk context mismatch pattern causes tool-errors failures
description: Multiple patch_file calls failed because hunk start lines in the @@ header did not match file content, even though context lines were correct. This pattern recurs when agents calculate line numbers manually. Expected impact: reducing these failures would improve rubric_score by eliminating tool-error Fail verdicts.
proposed_resolution: Add guidance to run.skill.md instructing agents to use write_file directly for small files (< 100 lines) rather than patch_file, reserving patch_file only for large files where a read-range was used to get exact line numbers.

title: patch_file should report which context line failed to match
description: Current error message 'error applying hunk #1' does not identify which context line mismatched, forcing the agent to re-read the file and regenerate. Expected impact: a more precise error would reduce mean iteration_count on patch_file retries.
proposed_resolution: Extend patch_file error output to include the first non-matching context line and its actual file content.

title: tag_run tool has no test coverage
description: tag_run.rs was created without a companion tag_run_tests.rs file. Other tools (create_candidate_tag, git_commit, create_branch) have test files. Expected impact: adding tests would reduce end_review_error_count in future runs that modify tag_run.rs.
proposed_resolution: Create src/moeb/src/tools/tag_run_tests.rs with tests for missing-field validation and git-invocation error handling.
